name: Time Labyrinth
source:
Time Labyrinth is a visual novel/dungeon crawler. The story is about a young man and his dog traveling back in time 10 seconds to avert a tragedy.

Genre: Visual Novel, Dungeon Crawler, Romance, Drama, Supernatural

- 11,000 words
- 3 Endings
- 4 CGs
- 4 regular enemies (+4 variations each), 8 bosses
- Adaptive music (during dungeon crawler)

"Ten confesses to his long time crush, Angel, but little does he know that the world’s out to ruin their date. The first problem seems to be that his dog Seconds is tagging along too, and after that it all goes downhill. Luckily Seconds can time travel 10 seconds into the past after exploring a deadly maze. It’s gonna be a long day."

The first release of Time Labyrinth was team mochalematazi‘s entry for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/]Ludum Dare 27[/url].

[From [url=http://timelabyrinth.vnovel.com/]official site[/url]]
translation:
《时间迷宫》是一款融合视觉小说与地牢探索的游戏。故事讲述一位年轻男子与他的狗回到十秒之前，试图阻止一场悲剧。

类型：视觉小说、地牢探索、恋爱、剧情、超自然。

•11000词。
•3种结局。
•4张CG。
•4种常规敌人，每种另有4种变体；8位首领。
•自适应音乐（地牢探索部分）。

“泰恩向暗恋已久的安吉尔告白，却不知道整个世界都在与他作对，想要毁掉这场约会。第一个问题似乎是他的狗‘秒钟’也跟了过来，之后事情就一路变糟。幸好，秒钟在探索一座致命迷宫后，能够回到十秒之前。这会是漫长的一天。”

《时间迷宫》的首个版本，是mochalematazi团队参加[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-27/]Ludum Dare 27[/url]的作品。
